about_the_game:
Welcome to a world where the boundary between reality and fantasy blurs! “Quadrober Simulator” offers a unique adventure in the skin of a virtual beast combining the features of a dog, fox or cat.

Game features:

Feel yourself in the pelt of the animal you want to be, whether it's a kitty, dog or foxy sister animal;

Show the hobbyhorse how to properly jump on a stick;

Bring a stick to your grandmother;

Bite everyone you don't like and don't understand you;

Try not to get caught by doctors, because they can send you to the nuthouse;

Check out the various youth memes;

Draw graffiti;

Turn other kids into quadrobers so you can have more fun together;

Get into fights with scoofs.

- Memes and Culture: Explore a virtual world full of modern youth memes and become a part of this subculture. Turn others into quadrobers to have more fun together.

- Social Clashes: Try your hand at exciting fights with scoofs and try to emerge victorious from various comical situations.

- Humor and Irony: The game is filled with apt jokes and comical situations that will make you laugh until you cry.

- Unique approach: Ordinary actions are turned into exciting mini-games and adventures.

- Sarcastic look at the routine: The game offers to see the usual things in a different light and to remember that even in everyday life you can find something funny and amazing.

Become part of the amazing life of Quadrober, have fun, have fun and explore this amazing world. Take the challenge and show how much you can rein in this comical and exciting story!

NOTES

The game is created for entertainment purposes only and is not intended to offend anyone.

Immerse yourself in nature and feel like a real Quadrober!
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500k (4 core 3.3 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 core 3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 4 GB or AMD Radeon™ RX 560 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel™ Core i7-3770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon™ RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
